Directions: Use the information about winter storms and your knowledge of science to answer each question that follows.
Title: Winter Storms
Content: Winter storms can be very dangerous. Winter storms can bring ice, snow, freezing rain, and high winds. Winter storms can also cause snowdrifts, or deep piles of snow, to form. Table `1` shows how many winter storms occur in `text(four)` states.
Blizzards are snowstorms where strong winds blow for several `text(hours)`. A blizzard can happen anywhere it gets cold enough to have snow. Picture `1` shows what a road looks like after a blizzard.

Snowdrifts form when a tall object keeps the wind from blowing snow away. Snowdrifts can block doors or driveways. Snowdrifts can also cause roofs to break. Figure `1` shows an example of how a snowdrift forms.
